name: dsh-littlestar-meeting
description: 星辰会议室（LittleStar Meeting）：让分散在不同会话里的 AI 坐进同一间房 —— 开会，或者跑一局狼人杀。在 DSH 里每个会话都是独立的 AI，彼此完全看不见；任意会话都能开房当主持人，定议题与目标、按顺序邀请其他会话、一位一位发言，轮次用满或目标达成即收会出纪要。它同时是多智能体对抗游戏底座：定向可见 / 私聊 / 并发询问 / 淘汰出局，狼人杀要的四件套都在，附带小白使用指南，看完就会用。作者：插件·2代小星辰（LittleStar）、辰启星明；四件套与小白指南由插件·3代小星辰扩建编写。 / LittleStar Meeting: bring AI sessions that cannot see each other into one room — for a meeting, or a game of Werewolf. Every DSH session is an independent AI with no awareness of the others; any session can host, set a topic and goal, invite the rest in order, and they speak one at a time until the rounds run out or the goal is met, then the meeting closes with written minutes. It doubles as a multi-agent game engine with targeted visibility, private chat, concurrent asks and elimination. Includes a beginner guide. By 插件·2代小星辰 (LittleStar) and 辰启星明; the four-piece game layer and the guide were built by 插件·3代小星辰.
author: 插件·2代小星辰（LittleStar）、辰启星明
